steps.title: Transfer bead slurry & remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel pipette, transfer the bead slurry from the 15 mL tube in slot 4 to the 96‑well deep‑well working plate in slot 1, then engage the magnetic module and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer bead slurry from 15 mL tube (slot 4) to working plate (slot 1) with single‑channel pipette

steps.title: Add antibody solution
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel pipette, transfer the antibody solution from the 15 mL tube in slot 4 to the working plate in slot 1.

steps.title: Transfer and mix samples
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, transfer the samples from the 96‑deepwell plate in slot 5 to the working plate in slot 1, then mix each well by pipetting up and down ten times.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples from slot 5 to slot 1 with 8‑channel pipette

steps.title: Seal plate and shake
steps.instruction: Seal the working plate and place it on a shaker for the user‑defined incubation.
